Business Growth Executive Job at Bloom Digital Media




        
    

        
        We are a leading Media and communications agency. We connect brands and people through stories and engaging experiences.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Growth Executive

Job Location: Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	The Business Growth Executive is responsible for driving Bloom's commercial growth by identifying, developing, and converting business opportunities into long-term client partnerships.
	This role is focused on revenue generation, strategic relationship management, and business development.
	The successful candidate willwork closely with the Lead, Growth & Business Operations to build a healthy sales pipeline, secure new business, expand strategic partnerships, and contribute directly to the achievement of Bloom's revenue objectives.


Required Experience


	Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Management, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Commercial Growth, Account Management, or a related role.
	Demonstrated ability to consistently generate revenue and acquire new business.
	Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify and pursue growth opportunities.
	Experience working in a marketing agency, advertising agency, technology company, media company, consulting firm, or other service-based business will be an added advantage.
	Bloom offers a competitive salary alongside a performance based commission structure designed to reward exceptional business growth and revenue generation.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV & Cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail

  "title": "Channel Sales Executive",
  "description": "The Simba Group which started operations in 1988, is a conglomerate having a Pan-Nigeria presence and business interests in some other most dynamic sectors in the economy. The Group is a dominant player in the transportation, power products and IT-enabled service sectors which are critical to the sustained growth of the Nigerian Economy.&nbsp;

The corporate vision of the Group is to provide innovative and quality products along with excellent aftersales service to our&nbsp;customers. The activities of the Group are guided by strong value systems built around Integrity, Innovation, Openness and Consistency. In our quest for diversification and expansion, we are looking for result-oriented professionals in the following discipline(s).

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Channel Sales Executive
Job Locations: Lagos, Anambra, Kano, Oyo, and Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Build, strengthen, and manage Territory reseller and channel partner networks.
	Appoint new distributors, dealers, and resellers in strategic locations.
	Maintain strong relationships with channel partners to ensure business continuity and growth.
	Provide first hand competition market analysis and possible solutions.
	Monitor channel and reseller performance, stock movement, and territory coverage.


Job Description


	Sales revenue achievement
	Channel expansion and active reseller growth
	Market share growth
	Retail sales performance
	Collection efficiency and stock movement
	Team productivity and performance
	Customer and partner satisfaction


Required Skills:


	Sales and Commercial Skills
	Analytical and Strategic Skills
	Communication and Relationship Management
	Industry and Product Knowledge
	Understanding of consumer buying behaviour and retail market dynamics.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: careers@simba.com.ng using the Job Position and location as the subject of the email.&nbsp;",

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Quality Control Manager (Automobile)",
  "description": "Simba Group which started operations in 1988, is a conglomerate having a Pan-Nigeria presence and business interests in some ofthe most dynamic sectors in the economy. The Group is a dominant player in the transportation, powerand IT-enabled service sectors, which are critical to the sustained growth of the Nigerian Economy. The corporate vision of the Group is to provide innovative and quality products along with excellent after-sales service to our customers. The activities of the Group are guided by strong value systems built around Integrity, Innovation, Openness and Consistency.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Quality Control&nbsp;Manager (Automobile)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Organization: Wandel International Limited
Base: Motorized Transport Division (MTD) &ndash; ACME, Lagos
Reporting line: MTD Assembly
Direct Reports: Assembly Head

Job Summary


	To ensure that all 2 &amp; 3-wheeler vehicles assembled meet defined quality standards and specifications by implementing effective quality control processes across the assembly line, minimizing defects, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory requirements.


Key Roles / Responsibilities
Quality Leadership &amp; Strategy:


	Develop, implement, and continuously improve quality control strategies, policies, and procedures for vehicle assembly operations.
	Lead and supervise the Quality Control team to ensure compliance with established quality standards.
	Establish quality objectives, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
	Promote a quality-first culture across the production floor.


Assembly Line Quality Control:


	Oversee in-process inspections at all critical assembly stages including chassis assembly, engine installation, electrical wiring, body assembly, painting, and final finishing.
	Ensure strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering drawings, and work instructions.
	Verify torque settings, alignments, clearances, and component fitments according to specifications.
	Ensure process discipline and standardization throughout the assembly line.


Final Vehicle Inspection (PDI):


	Manage Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) activities before vehicle dispatch.
	Verify engine performance, braking systems, electrical systems, suspension, steering, fit &amp; finish, lighting, and overall build quality.
	Approve vehicles for release or hold units requiring corrective action.
	Ensure zero defective vehicles leave the factory.


Defect Management &amp; Root Cause Analysis:


	Lead investigations into quality defects and non-conformities.
	Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using methodologies such as:
	
		5 Whys
		Fishbone Diagram
		Pareto Analysis
		8D Problem Solving
	
	
	Drive Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
	Monitor recurring issues and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented.


Process Quality Management:


	Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure consistent quality output.
	Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and Procurement to resolve quality issues.
	Drive First Time Right (FTR) manufacturing practices.
	Introduce process improvements that reduce variation and improve product quality.


Incoming Material &amp; Supplier Quality:


	Oversee inspection of CKD/SKD kits, components, and raw materials.
	Ensure defective or non-conforming materials are quarantined and reported.
	Work with Procurement and suppliers to resolve quality concerns.
	Monitor supplier quality performance and recommend improvement actions.


Quality Systems, Documentation &amp; Reporting:


	Establish and maintain inspection records, quality reports, defect logs, and traceability documentation.
	Develop quality dashboards and performance reports for management.
	Monitor key quality metrics including:
	
		First Pass Yield (FPY)
		First Time Right (FTR)
		Rework Rate
		Defect Per Vehicle (DPV)
		Customer Complaints
		Warranty Claims
	
	
	Present quality performance during management review meetings.


Compliance &amp; Quality Audits:


	Ensure compliance with internal quality standards and automotive manufacturing requirements.
	Lead internal quality audits and support external audits.
	Ensure audit findings are addressed through effective corrective action plans.
	Maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance and quality certifications.


Continuous Improvement:


	Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and Six Sigma improvement initiatives.
	Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve productivity, and enhance product quality.
	Recommend improvements to production processes, tooling, fixtures, and inspection methods.
	Support new product introduction (NPI) and process validation activities.


Training &amp; Team Development:


	Train Quality Officers, Inspectors, and Assembly personnel on quality standards and inspection procedures.
	Build team capability in problem-solving and quality tools.
	Promote a Zero Defect and Right First Time culture.
	Conduct periodic quality awareness sessions across the assembly department.


Qualification and Experience


	HND / Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or Industrial Engineering
	5 - 10 years of experience in automobile assembly or manufacturing (3-wheeler/2-wheeler preferred) with 2-3 years in supervisory role.
	Familiarity with CKD/SKD assembly processes is an advantage.


Skills and Competencies:


	Strong understanding of automotive assembly systems (engine, transmission, electricals)
	Knowledge of quality tools (RCA, 5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto)
	Attention to detail and inspection accuracy
	Problem-solving and analytical thinking
	Good communication and reporting skills
	Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.


Working Conditions:


	Shop floor / assembly line environment
	Requires standing, walking, and active supervision
	May require shift work depending on production schedule.

Quality Control Manager (Automobile) Job at Simba Group




        
    

        
        Simba Group which started operations in 1988, is a conglomerate having a Pan-Nigeria presence and business interests in some ofthe most dynamic sectors in the economy. The Group is a dominant player in the transportation, powerand IT-enabled service sectors, which are critical to the sustained growth of the Nigerian Economy. The corporate vision of the Group is to provide innovative and quality products along with excellent after-sales service to our customers. The activities of the Group are guided by strong value systems built around Integrity, Innovation, Openness and Consistency.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quality Control Manager (Automobile)
     

            
    



Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Organization: Wandel International Limited
Base: Motorized Transport Division (MTD) – ACME, Lagos
Reporting line: MTD Assembly
Direct Reports: Assembly Head

Job Summary


	To ensure that all 2 & 3-wheeler vehicles assembled meet defined quality standards and specifications by implementing effective quality control processes across the assembly line, minimizing defects, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory requirements.


Key Roles / Responsibilities
Quality Leadership & Strategy:


	Develop, implement, and continuously improve quality control strategies, policies, and procedures for vehicle assembly operations.
	Lead and supervise the Quality Control team to ensure compliance with established quality standards.
	Establish quality objectives, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
	Promote a quality-first culture across the production floor.


Assembly Line Quality Control:


	Oversee in-process inspections at all critical assembly stages including chassis assembly, engine installation, electrical wiring, body assembly, painting, and final finishing.
	Ensure strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering drawings, and work instructions.
	Verify torque settings, alignments, clearances, and component fitments according to specifications.
	Ensure process discipline and standardization throughout the assembly line.


Final Vehicle Inspection (PDI):


	Manage Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) activities before vehicle dispatch.
	Verify engine performance, braking systems, electrical systems, suspension, steering, fit & finish, lighting, and overall build quality.
	Approve vehicles for release or hold units requiring corrective action.
	Ensure zero defective vehicles leave the factory.


Defect Management & Root Cause Analysis:


	Lead investigations into quality defects and non-conformities.
	Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using methodologies such as:
	
		5 Whys
		Fishbone Diagram
		Pareto Analysis
		8D Problem Solving
	
	
	Drive Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
	Monitor recurring issues and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented.


Process Quality Management:


	Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure consistent quality output.
	Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and Procurement to resolve quality issues.
	Drive First Time Right (FTR) manufacturing practices.
	Introduce process improvements that reduce variation and improve product quality.


Incoming Material & Supplier Quality:


	Oversee inspection of CKD/SKD kits, components, and raw materials.
	Ensure defective or non-conforming materials are quarantined and reported.
	Work with Procurement and suppliers to resolve quality concerns.
	Monitor supplier quality performance and recommend improvement actions.


Quality Systems, Documentation & Reporting:


	Establish and maintain inspection records, quality reports, defect logs, and traceability documentation.
	Develop quality dashboards and performance reports for management.
	Monitor key quality metrics including:
	
		First Pass Yield (FPY)
		First Time Right (FTR)
		Rework Rate
		Defect Per Vehicle (DPV)
		Customer Complaints
		Warranty Claims
	
	
	Present quality performance during management review meetings.


Compliance & Quality Audits:


	Ensure compliance with internal quality standards and automotive manufacturing requirements.
	Lead internal quality audits and support external audits.
	Ensure audit findings are addressed through effective corrective action plans.
	Maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance and quality certifications.


Continuous Improvement:


	Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and Six Sigma improvement initiatives.
	Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve productivity, and enhance product quality.
	Recommend improvements to production processes, tooling, fixtures, and inspection methods.
	Support new product introduction (NPI) and process validation activities.


Training & Team Development:


	Train Quality Officers, Inspectors, and Assembly personnel on quality standards and inspection procedures.
	Build team capability in problem-solving and quality tools.
	Promote a Zero Defect and Right First Time culture.
	Conduct periodic quality awareness sessions across the assembly department.


Qualification and Experience


	HND / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or Industrial Engineering
	5 - 10 years of experience in automobile assembly or manufacturing (3-wheeler/2-wheeler preferred) with 2-3 years in supervisory role.
	Familiarity with CKD/SKD assembly processes is an advantage.


Skills and Competencies:


	Strong understanding of automotive assembly systems (engine, transmission, electricals)
	Knowledge of quality tools (RCA, 5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto)
	Attention to detail and inspection accuracy
	Problem-solving and analytical thinking
	Good communication and reporting skills
	Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.


Working Conditions:


	Shop floor / assembly line environment
	Requires standing, walking, and active supervision
	May require shift work depending on production schedule.
